summary: Turns a small subset of Markdown into styled text runs.
description: Bold, italic, code and links are recognised and become runs carrying the style each one implies, ready to be written into a slide or a cell. A theme can change what those styles are — the font of a code run, say — without touching the text.

params.theme: The styles each kind of run is given.

returns: the runs, in order, each with its text and its style.

throws.InvalidStringException: the text is not a string. An empty string is accepted and gives an empty array.
